feeds.title: The Cult of Calcio
feeds.description: If you are passionate about football in Italy, here's your privileged window on its stories, brought to you in English by Italians themselves. We Italians look at football just the way we look at food: It's a sublime pleasure, a matter of life and death, and a source of countless discussions.

feeds.title: Social Football Summit News
feeds.description: Social Football Summit was born in 2017 from a project by Go Project and Social Media Soccer, an international event dedicated to innovation and digital transformation in the football industry. Over the years it has become a professional point of reference in the football and sport sector in general. Through contributions and advances from Clubs, Federations, Media, and Companies, we present market trends and innovations.

feeds.title: FootItalia.com
feeds.description: FootItalia.com was established in 2022 to provide the latest news from around Italian football, with a focus on Serie A. We have match reports for the largest Serie A games each weekend, player ratings, the latest transfer news from verified sources, and the most important club news and announcements from the league itself.

feeds.title: Marca » Serie A
feeds.description: Read all the latest updates on Serie A, football, star players, and more. Marca magazine covers NFL, NBA, football, soccer, lifestyle, and more.

feeds.title: Get Italian Football News » Juventus
feeds.description: Get Italian Football News is your home for Italian football in English. GIFN provides extensive coverage of every Serie A club, the Italian national team, and all the goings-on across the Italian football landscape. Join us for detailed and immediate news stories from across the French media, analytical and insightful features, and everything in between, including podcasts and video content, from our dedicated news team and host of contributors.

feeds.title: Viola Nation
feeds.description: We are your best source for quality Fiorentina news, rumors, analysis, stats, and scores from the fan perspective.

feeds.title: Football-Magazine.it » Italian Cup
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date on the Italian cup. Football-Magazine.it serves you Coppa Italia news, standings, calendar, the latest news, and real-time updates on te national cup.

feeds.title: Calcio England
feeds.description: This project emerged from one Englishman's long-standing passion for Italian football. A passion first ignited by the sights, sounds, and stadia of the 1990 World Cup, and subsequently nurtured through Channel 4's coverage of Serie A's golden era. these themes resonate widely with visitors and followers drawn from all corners of the globe.

feeds.title: FIGC
feeds.description: The FIGC Communication Area identifies, plans, and organizes the internal and external communication of the Football Federation and relations with the Media and its stakeholders, to improve its reputation, support its strategy, and inform and educate public opinion, based on the values of football.

feeds.title: The Laziali
feeds.description: TheLaziali.com is the leading website dedicated entirely to Italian Serie A football club S.S. Lazio. The company was founded by Laziali, for Laziali, in February 2018 as a response to the lack of high-quality English content concerning the team, and is part of the Rocket Sports, NewsNow, OneFootball, and FotMob networks.
